title: stage-tiling-and-kv-warmup-hints-to-reduce-tail-latency
author: Marisol Nguyen
description: Motivation: tail latency for mixed-length requests (short chat turns interleaved with long completions) remains a significant pain point in production. Large prefill windows create kernel inefficiencies and cause KV cache churn when multiple long-prefix requests arrive concurrently. This PR introduces a stage-tiling model for the prefill stage plus an opt-in KV warmup hints channel to improve kernel reuse, reduce KV cache thrash, and overlap prefill and decode more efficiently. Changes: 1) Stage tiling: prefill work is split into fixed-size "tiles" (configurable per-model, default 64 tokens). Prefill tiles are scheduled as independent units enabling kernel microbatch fusion across tiles from different requests while preserving per-request ordering guarantees. 2) Asynchronous tile handoff: tiles are queued into a lightweight stage-tiling dispatcher that performs size-aware batching and forwards completed tiles to the decode stage with a small re-order buffer to tolerate out-of-order tile completion. 3) KV warmup hints: service-level metadata header allows the router to attach predicted future tile IDs and token ranges; runtime uses hints to prefetch KV pages and bias kernel selection (fp16 vs q4) for the next tiles. Hints are advisory and gated behind a feature flag. 4) Kernel hinting and eviction policy: add a tile-aware eviction score that prefers keeping KV state for active tiles and for hinted tile ranges; the policy uses a small LRU-with-weight heuristic computed by the serving runtime. 5) Config and observability: new runtime flags (tile_size, tile_reorder_window_ms, kv_hint_enabled) and metrics (tile_fusion_count, tile_out_of_order_pct, kv_hint_hit_rate). Motivation and rationale: tiling reduces stragglers caused by oversized prefill kernels and increases opportunities for microkernel fusion across short bursts. Warmup hints are low-cost metadata piggybacking useful in hybrid workloads where the client can provide next-token distribution shape or approximate token counts. Release notes: "Introduces stage tiling (configurable tile_size) and an opt-in KV warmup hint header to improve tail latency for mixed-length workloads. Enabled behind a runtime feature flag. Expect lower p95/p99 latencies for chat-like interleaved traffic; monitor kv_hint_hit_rate and tile_out_of_order_pct after rollout."
